items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Brian Clarenidison. What about tuba player with the Arnold? [INTERVIEWEE] Well the Arnold band was Eddie Jackson I believe, I recall. Eddie Jackson.

ctx.x: of those? I don't remember George Peele. I don't remember. If he did, he played in New Orleans with the brass band I remember. But I know he was in Chicago and he had parents living on the brass band. He was in San Anner Street in New Orleans before he died. And I didn't know much about George Peele. My daddy always talked about George Peele and George Bocquet and a lot of others. But I don't know George Bocquet. My daddy would tell me about him,
Brian Clarenidison. What about tuba player with the Arnold?

Well the Arnold band was Eddie Jackson I believe, I recall. Eddie Jackson. Did they have an alto horn or a baritone horn? Yeah. Alexander played, Adolph Alexander played baritone senior. That's Adolph's daddy. Tats' daddy. Living right about a block from here on the corner of me now. They don't stay there now, but they was staying there at the time. That's Tats' daddy. And he's passed. He passed too, yeah. He played baritone, he played euphonium too. I think he was an arranger. Well he used to write music and…
